news.title: Can we stop whining about spam now?
news.summary:
Can we all agree that we're done whining about spam on the Bitcoin network?

Before the birth of Bitcoin, there was Hashcash. This was a proposal to use proof of work to put a limit on the profitability of email spam. Sending emails is almost free. Sending a billion spam emails is almost negligible in cost.
